# Ordinance No. 08, Series of 2008

**Ordinance changing the name of Pitogo Community High School to Pitogo National High School**

## Summary

This ordinance changes the name of Pitogo Community High School to Pitogo National High School. The ordinance was enacted by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of Pitogo, Quezon on June 30, [[2008]], based on the recommendation of the school's faculty and in accordance with the [[RA-7160|Local Government Code of 1991]]. The change aims to reflect the school's status as a national high school under the national government.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** Pitogo Community High School shall be known as Pitogo National High School.
2.  **Section 2.** The ordinance shall take effect ten (10) days after posting in public places.
